authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10187.11 *mōṭṭa explicitly gives Old Marwari moṭaü big/fat and Gujarati moṭũ; the adjective is used in the source elder-sibling expression. The specific o-vowel subsection is selected, not the general *muṭṭa head or *mōṭṭha subsection. CDIAL 9661 gives Hindi/Marwari bhāī and Gujarati bhāi brother. Two ordered component edges preserve big/elder + brother, with regional final-vowel, aspiration and y/i notation retained. No inherited Sanskrit compound or settled local Indo-Aryan transmission is asserted. Exact response: moṭā bɦāi.
